notes.title: Playtest Day!
notes.content:
Greeting Vikings and Shield Maidens,

We are happy to announce that the playtest will commence Wednesday 08/28/2024. You will be able to download and play during this time. The playtest will go for 2 weeks and will be updated throughout those 2 weeks. To make Pantheon Rift even better, we ask you to participate in bug reporting, suggestions, etc. please join our discord with the link below. In discord, you have permission to use the bug report bot.  

During this 2 week period, some of us from the dev team will be streaming it on our official twitch page. We look forward to seeing you all on the battlefield! 

[u][b]Discord[/b][/u]: https://discord.com/invite/GZ7c9dM6jW
[u][b]Twitch[/b][/u]: https://www.twitch.tv/kyriestudios

notes.title: Update: Emails Received
notes.content:
[h1]Attention Vikings and Shield Maidens[/h1]

The email you had received to come play, then once clicked on given an error. This email was sent in error by steam. We apologize for this inconvenience and excitement. We are working diligently to bring you an awesome playtest. We would also like to extend our deepest thanks to everyone who is excited for Pantheon Rift. We are building this game for all of you. With out or team or you all, we wouldn't be where we are currently. 

Keep a lookout for out event updates! Don't forget to join our discord located on the main steam page! 

Regards,
Kyrie Studios Team

notes.title: Playtest Delay
notes.content:
Greeting Vikings and Shield Maiden's,

Due to unforeseen technical issues, we regret to inform you that we are unable to release the demo/playtest as originally planned. Our team is working tirelessly to resolve these issues, but at this moment, we cannot provide a specific timeline for when the demo/playtest will be ready.

We understand how much excitement and anticipation has built up around this release, and we share in your disappointment. Please know that our priority is to deliver the best possible experience, and we are committed to ensuring that the demo/playtest meets the high standards you expect and deserve.

We will keep you informed with regular updates on our progress and will notify you as soon as we have more concrete information. Thank you for your patience, understanding, and continued support as we work through these challenges.

Your passion and enthusiasm are what drive us, and we are dedicated to bringing you an incredible Pantheon Rift experience.

In the meantime, we will be releasing a gameplay trailer. This will be to give you more of an insight of what everything will look/play/feel like. 

Sincerely,

Brian
Founder/CEO
Kyrie Studios

notes.title: War Horn Sounds!!! Attention Vikings and Shield Maidens!!!
notes.content:
The time has come for us to finally release our first public playtest on Steam. Our playtest will leave you starving for more. Grab your weapons, board the boats, and set sail to bring fortune and prosperity to your clans. Here is one final saying from our studio to you. Don't forget to join our discord with your fellow Vikings and Shield Maidens!

[b]Odin! Wise and powerful ruler of Ásgarþr, god among the gods! Grant that I may be shielded from misfortune and death. We call on you here to go against our enemies. We call on you here to fight with us.[/b]

Sign-up for the Demo to join your fellow Vikings and Shield Maidens!

And Remember, 

[i]Never go even
a single step 
without a weapon at your side; 
You never know 
when you might find yourself 
in need of a spear.[/i]

       -The Wanderer's Havamal (Quote 38)
